# Rhizomatics

> Open source software for Home Assistant, MQTT, Docker self-hosting and marine SignalK integrations.

Rhizomatics is an open source organization publishing free, source-available tools that
integrate with Home Assistant, MQTT brokers, Docker, and the SignalK marine data standard. All
projects are hosted on GitHub at https://github.com/rhizomatics.

Each project with a documentation site publishes its own llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Start there
for installation, configuration and troubleshooting of a specific project:

- [Supernotify](https://supernotify.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): unified Home Assistant notifications, routed by transport, recipient and scenario
- [AutoArm](https://autoarm.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): automatic Home Assistant alarm panel arming from presence, sun and calendars
- [Remote Logger](https://remote-logger.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): Home Assistant logs and events to Syslog or OpenTelemetry
- [Appliance AutoNotify](https://appliance-autonotify.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): appliance cycle notifications and Live Activities for Home Assistant
- [Home Assistant REPL](https://homeassistant-repl.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): Python shell against a running Home Assistant, for custom component developers
- [Updates2MQTT](https://updates2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): Docker image and Git build update checks over MQTT
- [anpr2mqtt](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): ANPR/ALPR camera events to MQTT for Home Assistant
- [signalk-cli](https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): command line and Python client for SignalK History and Streaming APIs
- [signalk-einklabel-plugin](https://signalk-einklabel.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): SignalK data on eInk electronic shelf labels
- [signalk-datalab-plugin](https://signalk-datalab.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): marimo data analysis notebooks for SignalK, in the browser
- [Boat Tech Directory](https://boat-tech-directory.rhizomatics.org.uk/llms.txt): directory of boat software, hardware and data standards

SignalK plugins without a documentation site are documented in their GitHub README.

# Overview

# Rhizomatics

Open source software for automating homes and boats, focusing on Home Assistant, MQTT and SignalK.

- **[Home Automation](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/home-automation/index.md>)**

  ---

  Open source tools for Home Assistant, MQTT and Docker self-hosting.
- **[Sailing](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/sailing/index.md>)**

  ---

  Open source tools for SignalK, and a curated directory of boat technology.
- **[Organization](<https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk/organization/index.md>)**

  ---

  How we run our projects, and download statistics for our integrations.

# Projects

# Home Automation

Open source tools for [Home Assistant](<https://www.home-assistant.io/>), MQTT, and self-hosted automation. Everything here is free, source-available on GitHub, and designed to work well with the wider Home Assistant, Python and Docker ecosystems.

- **[Auto Arm](<https://autoarm.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Automatically arm Home Assistant alarm panels using calendars, presence, mobile actions, sun state and conditions.
- **[Supernotify](<https://supernotify.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Unified notification for Home Assistant, with chimes, voice announcements, camera snapshots, PTZ camera movements and more.
- **[Updates2MQTT](<https://updates2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Use Home Assistant's Updates dialog for self-hosted Docker container updates, with one-click pull and restart.
- **[anpr2mqtt](<https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Integrate ANPR/ALPR cameras via the file system, creating Home Assistant entities for plate reads, with optional UK DVLA lookup.
- **[Remote Logger](<http://remote-logger.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  OTEL and syslog native remote structured logging for Home Assistant.
- **[Home Assistant REPL](<https://homeassistant-repl.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Python REPL based developer shell for Home Assistant custom component development and data tinkering.
- **[Appliance AutoNotify](<https://appliance-autonotify.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Instant set up live activity notifications for household appliances, using Supernotify and Home Assistant
- :material-bluetooth-connected: **[pico-ble-proxy](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/pico-ble-proxy>)**

  ---

  Tiny Bluetooth LE proxy to run on ESP32 devices attached to a small Linux device like a router and act as a Home Assistant remote bluetooth adaptor. Designed for monitoring boats, will work on land too.

# Sailing

Rhizomatics builds open source tools for [SignalK](<https://signalk.org/>), the open marine data standard, intended for low power servers on small boats, alongside a curated directory of boat technology.

## Projects

- **[signalk-cli](<https://signalk-cli.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Command line access to SignalK APIs. Generate CSV or Apache Arrow dataframes from the History API, or use the exploration and analysis tools to investigate the preserved boat data.
- **[signalk-datalab-plugin](<https://signalk-datalab.rhizomatics.org.uk>)** *BETA*

  ---

  Interactive data analysis notebooks for SignalK, using [Marimo](<https://marimo.io>) running as WebAssembly in the browser. API and streaming access using a choice of Polars, Ibis Framework, DuckDB and signalk-cli,
- **[Boat Tech Directory](<https://boat-tech-directory.rhizomatics.org.uk/>)**

  ---

  A curated list of boat tech: NMEA and Seatalk, marine internet, open source projects, hardware vendors and educational resources.

  Also available as in 'awesome list' format as [awesome-boat-tech](<https://github.com/SY-Sea-Jade/awesome-boat-tech>)) and as a webapp plugin for SignalK
- **[signalk-bluetti-plugin](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-bluetti-plugin>)**

  ---

  Reads Bluetti power station sensor data for battery level, solar input, inverter and more, with configuration for dozens of models. Some newer models using encrypted data will need a vendor-supplied key.
- **[signalk-delta-squelch-plugin](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-delta-squelch-plugin>)**

  ---

  Minimizes noisy SignalK deltas and unnecessary database space/query time for analytics. Applies configurable rounding, skips updates within a tolerance of the last value (with a heartbeat to keep the stream alive), and rejects implausible position changes from GPS spikes.
- **[signalk-einklabel-plugin](<https://signalk-einklabel.rhizomatics.org.uk>)**

  ---

  Publishes SignalK data to cheap eInk electronic shelf labels over BLE, with simple SVG templating, access to data paths plus the Resources API, and scheduling based on time or change to a SignalK path. Handles ZhunyCo BLE labels and is extensible for other vendors.

  Also available as [signalk-einklabel-genai-plugin](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-einklabel-genai-plugin>) to generate ESL labels from a configurable LLM prompt.
- **[signalk-teltonika-sms-plugin](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-teltonika-sms-plugin>)**

  ---

  Notifications API implementation for text messaging. Sends SMS via the Web API on modern Teltonika RutOS modems/routers (minimum v7.6 of RutOS), with throttling and retry.
- :material-bluetooth-connected: **[pico-ble-proxy](<https://github.com/rhizomatics/pico-ble-proxy>)**

  ---

  Tiny Bluetooth LE proxy to run on ESP32 devices attached to a small Linux device like a router and act as a Home Assistant remote bluetooth adaptor. Designed for monitoring boats, will work on land too.
